olivia: Idea: 'validation lock' as a catalog lifecycle state. Enables customers to hold a version while we finish perf and embed checks. Need gates + TTL + rollback plan.
marco: Agree. Gate suggestions: 1) end-to-end regression <= 2% on golden set, 2) latency P95 delta <= 25ms (our 256-token baseline), 3) embedding drift median cosine < 0.035, 4) infra cost delta <= +6%.
talia: Ops: canary cadence -> 1% for 12h, 5% for 24h, 10% for 48h. Prewarm KV cache during canary; require hit rate >= 65% before bump. Rollback if error rate +0.7% or sustained GPU >88% for 20m.
devops-bot: Canary window reserved at 1715070000 for validation-lock infra tests.
noah: CS: customers want an 'escape window'. Default validation-lock TTL 60 days with UI renewal prompt at 10 days before expiry. Offer 30-day migration credits for pilot customers.
olivia: Action list: Marco -> formalize bench script and golden set; Talia -> add prewarm steps to runbook; Noah -> draft comms; I'll add UX copy for renewal. If no objections by EOD Monday I'll mark gates as draft.
